source:
An employee submits a travel request to the department manager. The department manager checks whether the requested dates are available. If the dates are available, the department manager approves the request. If the dates are not available, the employee revises the dates and resubmits the request to the department manager for the same date check. After approval, HR records the approved request.
Requested improvement: After approval and before HR records the request, Finance checks whether the estimated cost is within the approved budget. If it exceeds the budget, Finance asks the employee to revise the estimated cost; the employee revises it and Finance repeats the budget check. If it is within the budget, HR records the request as before. Keep the existing date-revision branch.
